websiteDescription:
This stand-alone audio solution solely focuses on the most popular mode of audio, Bluetooth. The BC4 Pre-Amp Bluetooth Controller from enables anyone with an enabled BT device to stream their favorite music out on the water. Thanks to its small footprint, it won’t take up much space on your boat, while the rotary encoder and large buttons are designed to be easily manipulated while you’re moving. Pairing to the controller is fast work, after which your phone or other device can safely tuck away in your glovebox, console, or pocket while you enjoy your musical experience. 
Installation is kept to the basics with nothing more than a 35mm hole to flush mount the INF-BC4 and keep all hardware neatly out of sight. When connected to an amplifier this all-weather product will offer you a heart-pounding audio experience with sophisticated styling to boot and simple, intuitive controls. An affordable alternative to a traditional stereo receiver
